title: Termius Student
description: Claim the GitHub Student Termius benefit, install the client, and prepare a host connection without storing credentials in the walkthrough.

steps.title: Open GitHub Student Developer Pack
steps.body: Sign in to GitHub with the account that has your education eligibility. CTRL never stores your GitHub password, student data, or account identifiers.
steps.humanGate: Sign-in, student verification, MFA, CAPTCHA and offer acceptance stay under your control.

steps.title: Find the Termius offer
steps.body: Use Find on page to highlight Termius if GitHub currently exposes it on this page. If GitHub changes the layout, search the Student Pack normally and continue.

steps.title: Open Termius
steps.body: Open Termius and sign in or complete the offer claim. Do not paste passwords, recovery codes, API tokens, or SSH private keys into the walkthrough.
steps.humanGate: Any login, consent, billing, terms, MFA or CAPTCHA step requires your confirmation.

steps.title: Install the client
steps.body: Open the official downloads page and install the appropriate mobile or desktop client.

steps.title: Add a host you control
steps.body: Create a host entry using connection details you already own. Keep private keys in your device or approved secret storage. The walkthrough does not need or retain them.
